_comment: Example geometry file. The real one (zones.json) is gitignored because
these are pixel coordinates for ONE camera at ONE resolution and mean
nothing on another setup. Generate yours with:
width/height record the frame the coordinates were drawn on. If the live
frame differs, FootfallTracker rescales the geometry to match.
line   : 2 points, the entrance. Click order sets which way counts as IN.
zone   : polygon, the queue area, timed as dwell.
ignore : list of polygons where detections are discarded entirely -
mirrors, screens, posters, windows onto a street.
